common.deleteConfirmGeneric: Confirm deletion? This cannot be undone.

errors.llm_unavailable: The model server is not responding. Check that LM Studio is running and the endpoint is correct.
errors.llm_timeout: The model did not respond in time.
errors.llm_model_not_found: Model not found or not loaded on the server.
errors.llm_auth: The provider rejected the API key.

memoryCategoryHelp.core: Stable identity: changes only with explicit approval
memoryCategoryHelp.semantic: Consolidated information: relationships, preferences, recurring subjects
memoryCategoryHelp.contextual: Bound to a scenario, isolated from the original identity

modeHelp.interview: Explore biography, psychology, beliefs and motivations
modeHelp.analysis: Step outside the simulation: analytical assessment, not character speech

projects.title: Projects
projects.subtitle: Each project is a story: it groups characters, scenarios and simulations
projects.empty: No projects. Create your first story.
projects.deleteConfirm: Delete project “{{name}}”? Its scenarios, sessions and contextual memories will be deleted; characters are kept.
projects.deleteCharactersToo: Also delete characters that belong only to this project
projects.saveTitle: Save the project to a file
projects.saveHelp: The file contains identities, memories, knowledge base, scenarios and, if selected, conversations and sessions.
projects.autosaveNote: Changes are saved automatically in the local database. “Save to file” creates a portable copy of the whole project.
projects.name: Name
projects.addExistingHelp: The same character can take part in several stories: identity and personal memories stay shared.
projects.removeFromProjectConfirm: Remove “{{name}}” from the project? The character is not deleted.
projects.noOtherCharacters: All characters are already part of this project.
projects.removeBlocked: “{{name}}” still takes part in scenarios of this project ({{scenarios}}): remove them from those scenarios first.
projects.moveHelp: Moving the scenario to another project adds its participants to that project.

characters.title: Characters
characters.subtitle: Independent identities, reusable across any universe
characters.empty: No characters yet. Create the first identity.
characters.emptyProject: No characters in this project. Create a new one or add an existing one.
characters.deleteConfirm: Delete “{{name}}” with all memories and conversations? This cannot be undone.
characters.importDone: Imported “{{name}}”: {{memories}} memories, {{conversations}} conversations, {{knowledge}} sources, {{revisions}} earlier versions.
characters.importSkipped: Not imported: {{memories}} contextual memories and {{sessions}} scenario sessions (scenario missing).
characters.importHelp: The character is imported as a new identity, with its history: existing data is never overwritten.
characters.importIntoProject: The character will be added to the project “{{name}}”.
characters.exportHelp: The file contains the identity with its history, personal memories and, if selected, conversations and knowledge base.

editor.identityNote: The profile is the character's canonical identity. Every change is recorded in the history and can be reverted.

help.biography: The character's history, independent of any narrative.
help.psychology: Describe a coherent individual, not a stereotype based on profession or nationality.

bigFive.title: Big Five (optional)
bigFive.help: Indicative tendencies, not a script: personality remains described by traits and psychology.

expertise.help: Expertise determines what the character can discuss competently; personality determines how. A label does not give the model real competence: quality depends on the connected LLM and the knowledge base.

languages.help: Native language, known languages and level. Proficiency is simulated, within the real limits of the chosen model.

knowledge.title: Knowledge base
knowledge.help: Local documents indexed for lexical search (SQLite FTS5) and, if enabled, semantic search. They are retrieved by relevance, treated as untrusted data and given to the model with their epistemic status.
knowledge.pdfExtracted: Text extracted from {{count}} pages: review it before saving.
knowledge.saveFirst: Save the character to add documents.
knowledge.pdfNote: Only selectable text is extracted from PDFs (no OCR for scanned documents).

model.title: Character LLM engine
model.help: The model interprets the character but does not contain it: changing it does not modify identity, memories or conversations. Different models may give interpretations of different quality.
model.saveFirst: Save the character to choose a specific engine.

history.restoreConfirm: Restore version {{version}}? The current state will be kept in the history.
history.variantsHelp: A variant is an independent copy (e.g. a younger self or an alternate universe). The original stays unchanged.

chat.placeholderNarration: Describe an event or the scene…
chat.placeholderAnalysis: Ask for an external analysis of {{name}}…
chat.sendHint: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line
chat.incomplete: Response interrupted: the partial text was saved.
chat.emptyScene: The scene is ready. Add narration or choose who speaks.
chat.deleteConversationConfirm: Delete the conversation and all its messages? Memories already extracted are kept.
chat.generatedNote: Generated lines are not canonical identity data.
chat.engineNotLoaded: Model not loaded yet: the first response will be slower
chat.autoTurnsHelp: Generate several consecutive turns using the turn management

inspector.history: History: {{included}} turns included, {{omitted}} omitted or summarized
inspector.fullPromptHelp: The context that would be sent to the model now, rebuilt from PERSONA's data (not from the model's memory).
inspector.noSummaries: No summaries. Summaries never replace the original messages.
inspector.speaker: Character
inspector.memoriesInScope: Memories in scope for this conversation

scenarios.title: Scenarios
scenarios.subtitle: Narrative universes to place existing identities in
scenarios.empty: No scenarios. Create a narrative universe.
scenarios.isolationNote: What happens in a scenario stays in the scenario: memories are contextual and never modify the original identity unless the author explicitly promotes them.
scenarios.participantKnowledge: What the character knows in this scenario
scenarios.removeParticipantConfirm: Remove the character from the scenario? Their contextual memories are kept.
scenarios.deleteConfirm: Delete the scenario? Sessions and contextual memories will be deleted; characters remain unchanged.
scenarios.exportHelp: The file contains the scenario, the participants' identities, relationships, events, contextual memories and, if requested, the sessions.
scenarios.importNew: Always import characters as new identities
scenarios.importDone: Imported “{{title}}”: {{imported}} new characters, {{reused}} reused, {{sessions}} sessions, {{memories}} contextual memories.

simulations.title: Simulations
simulations.subtitle: Shared scenes among several persistent characters
simulations.needParticipants: The scenario has no participants: add them on the scenario page.
simulations.noScenarios: First create a scenario with at least one participant.
simulations.help: Each turn is generated with the context of the speaking character only: identities, expertise and memories stay separate.

memory.title: Memory
memory.subtitle: Inspect, edit and organize memories
memory.promoteConfirm: Promotion creates a new personal memory; the original stays where it is. Continue?
memory.retrievalPlaceholder: Type a sentence to see which memories would be retrieved…
memory.lexicalNote: Lexical retrieval (FTS5): on its own it does not recognize synonyms or translations. Enable semantic retrieval in Settings to search by meaning, even across languages.
memory.proposedHelp: Proposed memories are not used until the author approves them.

settings.title: Settings
settings.conversationLanguageHelp: Response language for new conversations. It can be changed at any time without losing memory or personality.
settings.modelsHelp: PERSONA uses an OpenAI-compatible API. For LM Studio: open the Developer tab, start the local server and load a model. Default endpoint: http://localhost:1234/v1
settings.contextLengthHelp: Must match the context the model is loaded with in LM Studio.
settings.apiKeySet: Key stored on the local backend
settings.apiKeyEnv: Key provided by an environment variable
settings.apiKeyHelp: The key stays on the backend and is never sent to the interface.
settings.modelMissing: The configured model is not among the available ones.
settings.deleteModelConfirm: Delete this configuration? Characters using it will switch to the default engine.
settings.autoProcessHelp: After responses, beyond the threshold, PERSONA creates incremental summaries and extracts memories with provenance. Changes to core memory remain proposals to approve.
settings.reviewExtracted: Require approval for extracted memories too
settings.budgetHelp: Shares of the model's input context. Recent history uses the remaining space.
settings.restoreConfirm: Restore this backup? The current database will first be saved as a safety copy.
settings.importExportHelp: Export or import identities from the Characters page (JSON format documented in docs/export-format.md).
settings.localOnly: All data stays on this computer. No accounts, no telemetry.
settings.embeddingsHelp: Adds meaning-based search, even across languages, to lexical search using a local embedding model (for example a multilingual model such as bge-m3 or multilingual-e5 loaded in LM Studio). If the service does not respond, PERSONA automatically falls back to lexical retrieval.
settings.embeddingsRebuildConfirm: Recompute all embeddings? With a lot of data this may take a while.

importFile.isCharacter: This file contains a character: import it from Characters → Import.
importFile.isScenario: This file contains a scenario: import it from Scenarios → Import scenario.
importFile.isProject: This file contains a project: open it from Projects → Open from file.
importFile.notPersona: This file is not a PERSONA export.
importFile.newerVersion: This file was created by a newer version of PERSONA (format v{{version}}, supported up to v{{supported}}). Update the app to open it.

style.title: Style
style.fontTextHelp: Conversations, text fields and memories. “Typewriter” uses Courier Prime, bundled with the app.
style.accentHelp: The color is adjusted automatically to stay readable in both the light and the dark theme.

accents.default: Default (green in dark theme, orange in light)

style.previewText: “Binary stars have been dancing together for billions of years,” said Irina, without looking up from her notebook.
